listeners.map.sentences.rpIdNotCommon: The applications that read the sign-on session are on host names {{hosts}}, and webauthn.rpId ({{rpId}}) is not a domain all of them are under: a passkey registered on one is not usable on another. Set webauthn.rpId to the domain authn.cookieDomain names.
listeners.map.sentences.rpIdEmpty: The applications that read the sign-on session are on host names {{hosts}}, and webauthn.rpId is empty, so each is its own relying party: a passkey registered on one is not usable on another. Set webauthn.rpId to the domain authn.cookieDomain names.
